caption: Figure 1. A simple modification of the global average pooling layer combined with our class activation mapping (CAM) technique allows the classification-trained CNN to both classify the image and localize class-specific image regions in a single forward-pass e.g., the toothbrush for brushing teeth and the chainsaw for cutting trees .
description:
This figure is a visual representation of the class activation mapping (CAM) technique applied to a convolutional neural network (CNN). It shows two sets of images: one depicting people brushing their teeth and the other showing individuals cutting trees. The figure demonstrates how the CNN, trained for classification, can also localize specific regions of interest within the images using CAM. The heatmaps overlaid on the images highlight the areas of focus for the CNN, such as the toothbrush and chainsaw, indicating the regions most relevant to the classification task.

Text in figure: Brushing teeth, Cutting trees, class activation mapping (CAM), convolutional neural network (CNN).
